inlineSql: Select * From AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND SCHM_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT SCHM_CODE as SchmCode,SCHM_NAME As SchemeNameL,SCHM_AMT AS SchmAmtR,SCHM_TYPE As SchmTypeM FROM AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY SCHM_CODE

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,B.MEMB_AMT,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.GOLD_WT ELSE -A.GOLD_WT END)as MembGoldW,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE -A.ADJ_AMT END)as BalAmt FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,B.MEMB_AMT

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE as MembNoL,B.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.SCHM_CODE AS SchemeL,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.GOLD_WT ELSE 0 END) AS MembMtlWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '-' THEN A.GOLD_WT ELSE 0 END) AS MembAdjW,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE -A.ADJ_AMT END)as BalAmt FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,B.MEMB_AMT,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE -A.ADJ_AMT END)as MembAmt FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,B.MEMB_AMT

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE as MembNoL,B.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.SCHM_CODE AS SchemeL,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS MembAmtR,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '-' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS MembAdjR FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME

INSERT INTO DELETE_DATA(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,DELETE_DATE,VCH_TYPE,VCH_TIME,DELETE_TIME, BOOK_NAME,AC_CODE,AC_NAME,VCH_VAL_DR,VCH_VAL_CR,FINE_TYPE,VCH_FINE_DR,VCH_FINE_CR,HD_VCH_NO,MAIN_USER,DELETE_USER,VCH_DESC) SELECT A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ',B.BOOK_SNAME,VCH_TIME,' ? MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss ? ', SUBSTRING(B.BOOK_NAME,1,20),AC_CODE,AC_NAME,0,ADJ_AMT,'A',0,0,HD_VCH_NO,A.MAIN_USER,' ? ',SUBSTRING(VCH_DESC,1,149) FROM AD_ADJ AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '
DELETE FROM REMARK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,A.MEMB_CODE As MembL,B.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.SCHM_CODE As SchmL,A.MAIN_USER As UserL,SUM(A.MEMB_AMT) As MembAmtR,SUM(A.ADJ_AMT) As AdjAmtR FROM AD_ADJ AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,A.MAIN_USER ORDER BY A.VCH_NO
SELECT VCH_NO FROM AD_ADJ WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '
